name: Farming Simulator 26
summary:
Farming Simulator 26 brings a new challenge system to virtual farmers who want to combine the relaxing experience, the series is known for, with some motivations to earn rewards. Whether you want to follow guided tasks or simply enjoy farm life at your own speed, the choice is yours.

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.
